name: 19970-largebatch-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one node. The process layout is pinned in vllm-config.yaml rather than left to resolve.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params; KV is 128 KiB per token.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate = 50 requests/s, warmup the first 30% by completion, bounded at 3000 requests / 1200 s safety.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, prompt EXACTLY 256 tokens and output EXACTLY 200 (min = max), no prefix buckets, greedy at temperature 0.0; the backend forces ignore_eos, so every request really does emit 200 tokens. request_format is `plain` (spec.backend.request_format) and is REQUIRED: on the default `default-template` the backend calls apply_chat_template on a tokenizer wrapper that has no such method, and every request then fails before the engine is reached, at rc=0 with zero successes.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant generating fixed 200-token replies to short prompts at fifty requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: vLLM at commit 85bd6599e4574f405c6b7944380c16358d5949bc.
# FORMAT: every key must be top-level and every value must fit on ONE line -- an indented
# continuation line is skipped by the flat reader, and the key is silently dropped.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Pinned, not a default: at world_size 1 this engine otherwise resolves the backend itself, so
# the process layout would be a function of the rest of the configuration rather than declared.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

max-model-len: 4096

# Pinned, not defaults: the in-process API's usage context is in neither per-context dict of the
# batch defaults at this commit, so unpinned it falls through to 2048 / 128 -- and a 128-sequence
# cap would bind at this workload's running set. 8192 / 1024 is what `vllm serve` picks here.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# The last three are written out at the engine's own defaults so they cannot drift.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true
